info.name: Services Mobile API v1
info.description:
# Services Mobile API (v1)

Source of truth: `routes/api.php` under `/api/v1`.

## Apps
- **Customer app**: guest browse (home/catalog/search) + register/login for orders/payments/profile
- **Technician app**: login only (no register; created from Platform/Company admin), offers, order status, items
- **Public**: banners, companies (+ reviews), portfolio-projects browse/details, company technicians/price-list, CMS pages (no auth; optional Bearer on company show/technicians for is_favorite)

## Auth
- Laravel Sanctum Bearer token
- Customer login/register returns `{ token, token_type: "Bearer", user, customer }`
- Technician login returns `{ token, token_type: "Bearer", user, technician }`
- **Auth-optional (guest OK):** `GET /customer/home`, `/search`, `/service-categories` (+ children / problems / intake-fields), `/available-technicians`, `/booking-preview` — valid Bearer enriches home/favorite fields; missing token still returns 200
- **Auth required:** profile, notifications, addresses, favorite-technicians, favorite-companies, orders, pay-*, invoice, devices, feedback, complaints — `Authorization: Bearer {{customer_token}}` or `{{technician_token}}`

## Locale
- Query `?locale=ar|en` or header `Accept-Language: {{locale}}`
- Middleware: `SetApiLocale`

## Response shape
- API Resources typically have **no** top-level `data` wrapper (`JsonResource::withoutWrapping`)
- Paginated lists may still use Laravel pagination keys (`data`, `links`, `meta`) depending on endpoint

## Favorites (technicians + companies)
- Technicians: `GET/POST/DELETE /customer/favorite-technicians` (auth required)
- Companies: `GET/POST/DELETE /customer/favorite-companies` (auth required) — powers company page heart icon
- `GET /public/companies/{id}` is auth-optional: `is_favorite` is false for guests, real value with Bearer customer
- `GET /customer/available-technicians?service_category_id=&lat=&lng=&filter=available|all|favorites`
  - Response fields: `rating_average`, `rating_count`, `availability_status`, `distance_km`, `is_favorite`, `user.avatar_url`, `company.display_name`
- **No ETA fields from API** (neither company show nor technicians) — mobile keeps fallback e.g. "15 - 25 دقيقة" / derives minutes from `distance_km`
- **No `cover_url`** on Company model/API currently

## Typical customer flow
1. GET /customer/home (guest) → browse catalog/search
2. GET /service-categories (roots) → /{id}/children (subtypes; empty skips) → /{leaf_id}/problems → intake-fields
3. GET /available-technicians?service_category_id={leaf_id}&filter=available|all|favorites (technician linked to root covers children)
4. GET /booking-preview?technician_id=&service_category_id= (guest OK: technician card + company discount + price list + inspection_fee)
5. POST /customer/register or /login → save token (needed before create order / favorites mutation / pay)
6. POST /favorite-technicians/{id} or /favorite-companies/{id} (optional heart)
7. POST /addresses (if needed)
8. POST /orders
9. Pay placeholders / invoice (auth required)

## Typical technician flow
1. POST /technician/login → save token
2. PATCH /availability, PATCH /location
3. GET /order-offers → accept/reject
4. PATCH /orders/{id}/status + manage items

## Controllers
`app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/{Public,Customer,Technician}/`

request.description: Root Sanctum user endpoint. Requires any valid Bearer token.

item.name: Public
item.description: No auth by default. Optional Bearer on Show company + Company technicians for is_favorite. Home ads, companies, company reviews, portfolio browse/details, company technicians/price-list, CMS pages. Favorites exist for both technicians and companies. No ETA from server — mobile fallback e.g. 15-25 min / distance_km. No cover_url on company.

request.description: Active home-screen ads/slider within schedule window. Fields: title, subtitle, cta_label, image_url, link_type (none|url|category|company|screen), link_value, sort_order.

Active companies. Query: q (search name/slug), category_id, sort=featured|name|offers. Returns logo_url, offer_text when discounts loaded, availability_status when computed. Note: Companies tab browse gallery uses List portfolio projects (browse), not this list alone.

Company details for Active companies only (404 otherwise). Auth-optional Sanctum.

Fields (withoutWrapping top-level):
- Display: id, logo_url, display_name + name_ar/en, display_short_description + short_description_ar/en, display_description + description_ar/en, display_warranty_note + warranty_note_ar/en
- Status/offers: availability_status (available|unavailable), offer_text, active_discount_type/value, rating_average, rating_count, is_featured
- Favorite: is_favorite (false for guest; real value with Authorization: Bearer {{customer_token}})
- reviews_preview[] (up to 3 recent published reviews)
- default_inspection_fee

NOT returned: cover_url (not on Company model), eta_min/eta_max/arrival_eta_text — mobile keeps ETA fallback (e.g. 15-25 دقيقة).

request.description: Public works browse for the Companies explore gallery (search + category chips). Approved+active projects for Active companies. Query: q, service_category_id|category_id, page. Each item: id, display_title/title_ar/en, image_url, images[], service_category_id, company{id,display_name,name_ar/en,logo_url}, technician{display_name,rating_*,availability_status,avatar_url}. Sorted is_featured desc then completed_at desc. This endpoint powers browse — not list companies alone.

Work/image details. App uses JsonResource::withoutWrapping(), so project fields are top-level (id, display_title, image_url, description/location, technician, company) and similar_works[] is in the same payload. similar_works = other approved+active works with same service_category_id (else same company_id), exclude current, max 12, with image_url. 404 if not approved/active or company not Active. No ETA from API.
Public content page by slug. Default env page_slug=guarantees. Returns title/body localized fields.

request.description: Creates user+customer. Body: name, email, phone?, password, password_confirmation. Response 201: token, token_type, user, customer.
Customer-only login. Revokes prior tokens. Body: email, password, device_name?. Saves customer_token.

Current customer profile + unread_notifications_count.

Soft-deletes the authenticated customer account (user + customer profile) and revokes all Sanctum tokens.

Responses:
- 200 `{ ok: true, message }` on success
- 401 without a valid Bearer token
- 422 when the customer has active (non-terminal) orders — terminal = completed|cancelled|expired

Use from Account settings gear → Delete account. Locale via Accept-Language only (no language API).

item.name: Customer / Catalog
item.description:
Auth-optional guest browse for choose-service:
1) GET /service-categories → root circles only (parent_id=null)
2) GET /service-categories/{id}/children → subtypes for segmented bar ([] skips)
3) GET /service-categories/{leaf_id}/problems → title + description_ar/en + icon_url
4) GET intake-fields → available technicians
5) GET /booking-preview?technician_id=&service_category_id= → technician + company + price list + inspection_fee (guest OK; optional q search)
6) Create order / pay inspection still require auth (Bearer).

request.description:
Auth-optional (except filter=favorites → 401 without token). Returns TechnicianResource with rating_*, availability_status, distance_km, is_favorite, user.avatar_url, company.logo_url + active_discount_*. No ETA from server — mobile derives minutes from distance_km.

Each technician includes: is_accepting_orders, queued_orders_count, estimated_wait_minutes, estimated_wait_label. Use filter=all to browse busy technicians and show queue wait before booking.

query.description: Optional. Used when resolving inspection_fee for a specific problem
Optional search within price list item names/descriptions

request.description:
Auth-optional guest screen for technician card + company offer + searchable price list + inspection fee CTA.

Response `data`:
- `technician` — TechnicianResource including is_accepting_orders, queued_orders_count, estimated_wait_minutes, estimated_wait_label
- `company` — CompanyResource
- `price_list` / `price_items[]`
- `inspection_fee`, `currency`, `is_favorite`
- `queue` — {queued_orders_count, estimated_wait_minutes, estimated_wait_label, is_accepting_orders, estimated_job_duration_minutes}

Show wait copy like: '3 orders in queue — you will wait about 2 hours' using queue fields.
Create order blocked when is_accepting_orders=false.
